Synopsis:
A bandit who is part of a crew looting an abandoned chapel - at this point, he's seen the players entering the chapel - 'the uninvited guests' - and thinks they're after the same loot as his crew. He's calling his friends to help.

Cluster Contexts:
- CHA_Outside_BanditBackInteraction_Spotted.json: Right outside of the abandonned chapel of Selune you encounter a few bandits arguing among themselves. They are rightfully surprise to see you get out of the ruins and worried about the fate of their friend inside.
- CHA_Outside_BanditInteraction.json: The bandits are encountered near an abandoned chapel and are in the middle of an argument among themselves about whether or not to investigate (and loot) the crashed nautoloid (a spaceship) when the player approaches them. The player can convince them to clear off via lies or threats, or else is forced to fight them. A gnome named Gimblebock is in charge of this group, with his underlings, Quelanna and/or Taman, chiming in at points with their concerns.
- FOR_ApothecaryGoblins_Goblin_02.json: This goblin is leading a band of looters in an abandoned house. They're too distracted by greed to fight, but if the player persists they'll attack.
- LOW_HagSurvivors_AD_Bandits_CombatStart.json: AD played by bandits when combat with players starts. These bandits are hiding from the steel watch in an abandoned building when the player comes upon them.

context: Andorn is one member of a small crew of looters currently ransacking an abandoned chapel of Selûne; the group has been distracted by arguing over what to take and whether to investigate the crashed nautiloid nearby. He has just spotted the player characters entering the chapel and assumes they’re rival scavengers after the same loot, so he yells for his comrades to come help. The crew is led by a gnome named Gimblebock (with underlings like Quelanna and Taman in the group), and while some approaches can sometimes scare or trick these looters off, in this encounter Andorn’s shout precipitates an immediate hostile reaction and the band prepares to engage.
